title: TaxiderMeme
tagline: Humanely framed memes, stuffed, and mounted on a wall to decorate your meta-home (Your Twitter Banner).
description: If PFPs are your identity in the metaverse, then your Twitter profile is your home, and your Banner says a lot about you. You can think of it as the equivalent of walls in your home, which is a great place to display things... like taxidermy! Except we don't hunt animals in the metaverse... we hunt Memes! Taxidermemes is the NFT collection for truly expressing your fine acquired taste of delicate memery. The proceeds of this NFT drop will be donated to the Gitcoin Grants Matching Pool as an ode to the founders' appreciation of public goods. Follow Taxidermemes on Twitter (@taxidermemes), minting information in the bio!
how_its_made: This project uses Vyper's ERC721 token implementation for the NFT contract. It also leverages IPFS to store the image files as well as the NFT metadata json files. The contract is tested and deployed using Brownie. The minting process takes place through Etherscan and is documented both on our Twitter (@taxidermemes) and GitHub (https://github.com/vintrocode/taxidermeme-nft).
